key_findings: Intrathecal and intravenous RvD2 prevented and reversed neuropathic and bone cancer pain in mice.
RvD2 suppressed spinal IL-17, CXCL1 and astrocyte activation; IL-17 neutralization reduced pain and CXCL1.
